closedDefects.resolution: The engine imports no cohort constructor and contains no R11 cleanup, cohort ID, headword, cohort path, or fixed /tmp alias.
Schema v2 binds startedEpoch, timegate, watchdog receipt, command audit, engine SHA, config, selection and research; artifact paths, hashes and mtimes are checked before output.

Unknown top/path/entry keys are rejected; ordinary size is 1-3; deterministic IDs are recomputed; selection, research, config and watchdog IDs must match exactly and in order; every governed path is contained in the authorized build root.
The engine invokes the real compile_evidence_draft.py with --new-entry; the integration test executes that branch through the watchdog CLI.
The first product is compiled entry-by-entry, hashed, receipt-bound to startedEpoch, and rejected after elapsed 270 seconds.
Real preclosure validation runs, errors block closure, and manifest/closure are rejected after elapsed 330 seconds.
The corrected engine no longer imports or mutates the shared cohort constructor module; compilation is subprocess-isolated.

The integration test starts the receipt first, creates all fixture artifacts afterward, invokes the engine through the real watchdog command, runs real compilation and preclosure for three entries, and proves first-product, manifest and closure outputs.
